The product compiler does not import ownership_summary_body.ft or ownership_summary.ft, so
a mutant changes no compiler binary. The build writes the LLVM IR of the origin test,
which compiles both modules from src/fort, and the runner compares that file. The stages
compile the mutant through the flags of each test. Build the debug preset first, on a
The md5 guard reads that LLVM IR file. A table whose binary is the compiler reads
stale on each row. 9 rounds took 119 s.
build: mkdir -p build/Darwin/debug/mutate && build/Darwin/debug/fort --std-dir build/Darwin/debug/std -I src/fort -I test/fort/support -S -o build/Darwin/debug/mutate/ownership_calls_origins_test.ll test/fort/ownership_calls_origins_test.ft

stages.name: the origin suite
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Darwin/debug/fort --std-dir build/Darwin/debug/std --cc /opt/homebrew/bin/clang --target arm64-apple-macosx11.0.0 -j 10 ownership_calls_origins

stages.name: the summary suites
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Darwin/debug/fort --std-dir build/Darwin/debug/std --cc /opt/homebrew/bin/clang --target arm64-apple-macosx11.0.0 -j 10 ownership_calls_ ownership_recursive ownership_indirect ownership_summary_

mutations.what: an unknown origin drops its requirement without a record
a lost requirement leaves the published summary complete
a result that the callee loaded from caller storage names no source
an argument with an unknown origin gives the result a known origin
a result that can name a caller source or no source keeps the caller source

mutations.old: return mapped_origin{scan_origin(in, out, rv, targets, args, false).origin, false};
mutations.new:
origin_scan open = scan_origin(in, out, rv, targets, args, false);
        return mapped_origin{open.origin, open.unknown};
mutations.what: a call whose normal cases the arguments refute marks its result unknown
the pointer field of a span drops the unknown mark of the span
a block entry drops the unknown mark of its parent block
the join of two call results ignores their sources and region keys
every check kind is true on success, as before the fix
